mu_name_from: Data/Item/Spear01.bmd, MODEL_SPEAR -- the first spear item, loaded at ZzzOpenData.cpp:652-656 -- and made as an effect by Death Stab's thrust (ZzzCharacter.cpp:2679-2680, `CreateEffect(MODEL_SPEAR, Position, o->Angle, Light, 1, o)`).
why_this_one: Death Stab (AT_SKILL_DEATHSTAB): on AttackTime 6 to 12, one frame in two, two of these at the spear's link bone pushed 100 + (AttackTime - 8) * 10 units along his facing (ZzzCharacter.cpp:2679-2680). **Never drawn**: an item model, with no render handler, and RenderEffects' legacy switch draws only MODEL_SKILL_BEGIN..END (ZzzEffect.cpp:8736-9647). It is kept here for its notes and as the folder's model; what is seen of it is the BITMAP_FLARE joint at sub-type 12 it lays every frame of its ten (EffectBehaviors.cpp:88-94), on Flare.png. game/fx/deathstab.h draws that.
mesh_from: muextract export-obj on Data/Item/Spear01.bmd, from MuMain: 128 triangles in two meshes, 321 units long down its own Z.

parts.note: Data/Item/sword12.OZJ, 32 x 16: the shaft and head.
Data/Item/sword12_3.OZJ, 32 x 16: the blade's edge. MU marks this mesh NoneBlendMesh (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1245).

Not a mesh of the spear: the sheet of Death Stab's gathering streaks, carried in this folder. Effect/NSkill.OZJ, BITMAP_FLARE_FORCE (ZzzOpenData.cpp:5319), worn by MODEL_SPEARSKILL's sub-type 2 joint -- five tails, twenty frames, Light (1, 0.3, 0.3), Scale LifeTime * 3 (ZzzEffectJoint.cpp:1568-1572, 4280-4297).

Not a mesh of the spear: Effect/Flare.OZJ, BITMAP_FLARE (ZzzOpenData.cpp:5297, clamped), the sheet of the sub-type 12 joint each invisible spear lays -- Light (0.1, 0.1, 1), Scale 100, LifeTime 70, fifty tails (ZzzEffectJoint.cpp:1876-1886).
